verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing documents its own background automation. It automates recurring payments and billing periods, Smart Retries automatically retry failed payments, and 'Stripe Billing automations' control customer communications. However, user-configurable automations are only named in a single thin mention, with no detail on triggers, conditions, or setup. Missing for 10: documented user-defined automation builder (triggers/actions/conditions), depth on configuring Billing automations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automate many of your customer interactions by combining a customer portal with customer communications controlled by Stripe Billing automations.
Stripe Billing can automatically retry failed subscription and invoice payments for you.
It automates recurring payments, creates custom pricing plans, and handles billing periods, such as trials and renewals.
